description: The backups of the data Neblla keeps for an app: the copies of the last 7 days (30 with Pro; `keepDays` says which), taken from Neblla's daily encrypted copy of its databases. "list": enabled (whether Neblla keeps copies at all), envs.pro / envs.pre (byodb, usesProData, the last restore), days: [{ date, createdAt, pro, pre }] with how many rows of each kind the copy holds — players, saves, tables, inbox, community, chat, rooms, purchases, customers (null with the developer's own database, which Neblla does not copy). "status": the restore of an environment (env: running | done | failed | interrupted, restored per kind, erasedSince, cost). Changes nothing; neblla_backups restores.
name: neblla_backups_read
title: Backups (read)
